info.name: AveeCare API v1.0.0
info.description:
The AveeCare REST API for home care agencies. Generated from the public OpenAPI specification.

Set the `AVEECARE_API_KEY` collection variable to a key from Settings → API Keys in AveeCare. Change `baseUrl` only to point at a sandbox.

Docs: https://www.aveecare.com/docs/api

item.name: Patients
item.description: Patients are the clients your agency provides care to, including prospective clients you have not yet admitted.

request.description:
Returns a page of patients. Filters combine with AND. Use `next_cursor` to fetch the next page.

Required key scope: `read`.

header.description: A unique value (a UUID works well) that makes this request safe to retry for 24 hours. A retry with the same key and body returns the first result; the same key with a different body is refused with `idempotency_conflict`.

request.description:

Required key scope: `write`.

item.name: Visits
item.description: Visits are scheduled or completed caregiver shifts at a patient's home. A visit's patient, caregiver, times and status are set when it is created; reschedule or reassign a visit in AveeCare.

query.description: Number of objects to return, from 1 to 100.
The `next_cursor` from the previous page. Send the same filters with it.
Start of the window (inclusive), ISO 8601 with a time zone. Visits are listed by scheduled start. Both `start_from` and `start_to` are required, and the window can be at most 93 days.
End of the window (exclusive), ISO 8601 with a time zone. At most 93 days after `start_from`.
Only return visits for this patient.
Only return visits assigned to this caregiver.
Only return visits with this status.
Only return objects created after this time (exclusive). ISO 8601 with a time zone.
